Subject: Request: cohort onramp promo for Orbit Labs cohort

Hi Jasmine,

Hope you’re well — Maya from Maya Ventures here. We’re preparing for the Orbit Labs demo week (cohort demo day on 2026-06-20) and would like to provide each startup in the cohort a self-serve top-up so they can prototype live demos on Redwood ahead of the event.

Quick details:
- Cohort size: 12 startups (see attached roster)
- Desired: one-time promo per company to cover ~2–3 weeks of prototyping (we’d like to request a $5k-equivalent credit top-up per startup)
- Timeline: ideally codes issued by EOD 2026-06-15 so founders can onboard and test.

We’ve used Redwood for a few portfolio founders already and they reported great perf. We can provide cohort verification materials (official invite PDF + incorporation for each company) — attaching the roster now. Please let me know the self-serve flow and any proof you need.

Thanks,
Maya Patel
Program Lead, Maya Ventures
maya@mayaventures.com

Hi Maya — thanks for the note and for the roster. Happy to help get this moving. A couple quick items so we can process as self-serve/top-up promos: 

1) Verification: we need either a cohort invite PDF (on org letterhead) or one incorporation doc per company. If you can zip those and upload, that works.
2) Promo sizing: our usual program template supports 8–10 startups at the $5k-equivalent level for accelerator partners; larger cohorts often get a mixed tiering (e.g., 8 at $5k + rest at $1k). Do you want us to keep all at $5k?
3) Expedited path: Sales Ops can do a bulk promo issuance if you provide a CSV with company name + contact email. That avoids manual code creation.

I’m looping Marissa (Sales Ops) to confirm the ops path and Karthik for billing/limits. We’ll aim to confirm by midday.

— Jasmine
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Urgency: demo day is next Saturday (20th), so same-day issuance is ideal. Appreciate any expedited help.

- Cohort size: 12.
- Promo recommendation: approve 10 startups at $5k-equivalent, 2 at $1k-equivalent (to limit risk while keeping the cohort effective).
- Reason: consistent with previous accelerator top-ups (captures runway for demos while mitigating potential abuse).

Karthik — can you issue a bulk promo via the internal bulk-promo tool (see link in metadata) and load the promo codes into the CSV template I attached? Use deal id HS-7892 and tag the promos as MAYA-ONRAMP-2026. Please confirm once created so I can share with Maya.
